description.value: Modern Handi is a West End neighbourhood staple that has been serving bold, authentic Indian cuisine on Denman Street for over nine years, just steps from Stanley Park and English Bay. The kitchen specialises in clay-oven tandoori dishes and rich curries, with a signature Mixed Grill Platter drawing repeat visitors. Online ordering with same-day pickup makes it a convenient fuel stop for cyclists exploring the seawall area.
